name.zh: 浏览器凭证采集工具命令（迁移）

description.zh: 包含复制 Chrome 登录/Cookie 数据库及运行 SharpWeb、HackBrowserData 的完整操作命令，属于后渗透工具参考而非浏览器 Payload。
description.en: Contains complete operational commands for copying Chrome login or cookie databases and running SharpWeb or HackBrowserData, making it a post-exploitation tool reference rather than a browser payload.

prerequisites.zh: 已确认四个 execution 项均为完整 PowerShell/工具 CLI，不含浏览器输入点、HTML 解析或 WebSocket 消息边界。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that all four execution items are complete PowerShell or tool CLI commands with no browser input point, HTML parsing, or WebSocket message boundary.

prerequisites.zh: 目标工具卡 post-exploitation-windows 与 post-exploitation-tools 存在，并已定义敏感输出的授权、加密与删除要求。
prerequisites.en: The destination cards post-exploitation-windows and post-exploitation-tools exist and define authorization, encryption, and deletion requirements for sensitive output.

overview.zh: 浏览器凭证采集工具命令（迁移）聚焦四项命令分别复制 Chrome 数据库或调用专用采集工具，只能在已获主机执行权限后使用，不能发现 Web 漏洞。 审校时必须先确认浏览器/协议版本、执行主体和受控测试对象，并保留正常基线。
overview.en: Browser Credential Collection Commands (Tool Migration) focuses on this boundary: The four commands copy Chrome databases or invoke dedicated collection tools and require existing host execution; they cannot discover a web vulnerability. Confirm browser or protocol version, execution principal, and controlled test objects, and retain a normal baseline.

vulnerability.zh: 原条目将后渗透操作命令误归为浏览器攻击 Payload，导致工具能力与漏洞触发条件混淆。 风险必须落到实际浏览上下文、消息 sink、认证主体或后端资源，不能从字符串外观推断。
vulnerability.en: The source misclassified post-exploitation operations as browser attack payloads, conflating tool capability with vulnerability trigger conditions. Risk must be tied to the actual browsing context, message sink, authenticated principal, or backend resource rather than inferred from string appearance.

exploitation.zh: 按 execution 索引 0-1 迁入 Windows 后渗透命令，2-3 迁入通用后渗透工具，并保持命令字节与标题对应。 迁移证据是每项可独立运行并产生文件或工具输出；成功复制数据库或导出凭证不代表浏览器页面存在漏洞。 关联浏览器 DevTools、握手/消息日志和后端审计，形成明确阳性与阴性对照。
exploitation.en: Route execution indexes 0-1 to Windows post-exploitation commands and 2-3 to general post-exploitation tools while preserving command bytes and titles. Migration evidence is that each item runs independently and produces a file or tool output; copying a database or exporting credentials does not prove a browser-page vulnerability. Correlate browser DevTools, handshake or message logs, and backend audit to establish explicit positive and negative controls.

mitigation.zh: 从 Payload 导航移除该记录，目标工具卡标注 DPAPI、浏览器锁文件、管理员权限与敏感数据保留边界。 修复后重放相同对照，合法浏览器/WebSocket 功能应保留，越权能力或解析差异应消失。
mitigation.en: Remove the record from payload navigation and document DPAPI, browser locks, privilege requirements, and sensitive-data retention in destination tool cards. Replay the same controls after remediation; valid browser or WebSocket behavior should remain while unauthorized capability or parsing differences disappear.

title.zh: 确认浏览器凭证工具前置条件

description.zh: 四项命令分别复制 Chrome 数据库或调用专用采集工具，只能在已获主机执行权限后使用，不能发现 Web 漏洞。 记录正常行为、组件版本、安全头、消息 schema 及相关日志。
description.en: The four commands copy Chrome databases or invoke dedicated collection tools and require existing host execution; they cannot discover a web vulnerability. Record normal behavior, component versions, security headers, message schema, and relevant logs.

title.zh: 执行受控浏览器凭证工具对照
title.en: Run a controlled Browser Credential Tools comparison

description.zh: 按 execution 索引 0-1 迁入 Windows 后渗透命令，2-3 迁入通用后渗透工具，并保持命令字节与标题对应。 一次只改变一个浏览器能力、消息字段或协议边界，并使用无害标记。
description.en: Route execution indexes 0-1 to Windows post-exploitation commands and 2-3 to general post-exploitation tools while preserving command bytes and titles. Change one browser capability, message field, or protocol boundary at a time and use a harmless marker.

attackChain.payload: Get-ChildItem -Path "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Google\Chrome\User Data\Default\Login Data" | Copy-Item -Destination "C:\temp\Login Data"

title.zh: 核对浏览器凭证工具阳性边界
title.en: Verify Browser Credential Tools positive boundaries

description.zh: 迁移证据是每项可独立运行并产生文件或工具输出；成功复制数据库或导出凭证不代表浏览器页面存在漏洞。 同时排除回显、客户端自执行、通用错误和手工客户端伪造能力。
description.en: Migration evidence is that each item runs independently and produces a file or tool output; copying a database or exporting credentials does not prove a browser-page vulnerability. Also exclude reflection, client self-execution, generic errors, and capabilities introduced only by a manual client.

title.zh: 修复并回归浏览器凭证工具
title.en: Remediate and regress Browser Credential Tools

description.zh: 从 Payload 导航移除该记录，目标工具卡标注 DPAPI、浏览器锁文件、管理员权限与敏感数据保留边界。 重放正常、阳性和阴性样例并完成测试数据清理。
description.en: Remove the record from payload navigation and document DPAPI, browser locks, privilege requirements, and sensitive-data retention in destination tool cards. Replay normal, positive, and negative cases and complete test-data cleanup.

analysis.zh: 四个命令没有可注入数据位置：前两项是本地文件复制，后两项是工具启动。阳性只能证明已授权主机上的采集工具可运行；文件存在、工具返回空结果或浏览器保存过密码都不是 Web 漏洞证据，因此决策必须为 tool。
analysis.en: None of the four commands contains an injectable data position: the first two copy local files and the latter two launch tools. A positive result proves only that collection tooling runs on an authorized host; file existence, empty tool output, or saved browser passwords do not establish a web vulnerability, so the decision is tool.

opsecTips.zh: 迁移审阅不执行真实凭证导出；如需冒烟测试，只使用一次性浏览器配置和伪造账户，首个测试记录被识别后停止。
opsecTips.en: Do not export real credentials during migration; if smoke testing is required, use a disposable browser profile with a fake account and stop after the first test record is identified.

opsecTips.zh: 删除复制的 Login Data/Cookies、工具输出和临时目录，关闭测试配置并确认日志与报告中没有 Cookie、密码或密钥。
opsecTips.en: Delete copied Login Data, Cookies, tool output, and temporary directories, close the test profile, and verify that logs and reports contain no cookies, passwords, or keys.

review.rationale: 四项均为完整后渗透 CLI，缺少浏览器请求或解析上下文，应迁工具。

name.zh: target=_blank 的 opener 隔离对照

description.zh: 比较 rel=opener、noopener、noreferrer 与无相关关键字时新标签页是否保留 opener，并以现代浏览器隐式 noopener 为基线。
description.en: Compares rel=opener, noopener, noreferrer, and unrelated link types for opener retention in a new tab, using modern implicit noopener behavior as the baseline.

prerequisites.zh: 使用支持 target=_blank 隐式 noopener 的当前浏览器，并记录版本、COOP 响应头与扩展策略。
prerequisites.en: Use a current browser that implements implicit noopener for target=_blank and record the version, COOP headers, and extension policies.

prerequisites.zh: 测试链接和目标页均由授权域控制，目标页只读取 `window.opener === null` 并返回固定布尔标记。
prerequisites.en: Both link and destination pages are controlled, and the destination only reports a fixed Boolean marker for `window.opener === null`.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 target 空白新页的 opener 隔离场景，检验不同 rel 组合下新标签页对原窗口的引用保留。验证维度为 opener、noopener、noreferrer 与缺省四类组合的对照，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers opener isolation for blank-target new pages, testing whether new tabs keep references to the original window across rel combinations. Validation contrasts opener, noopener, noreferrer and default combos, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于旧浏览器对 target 空白链接默认传递 opener 引用：被打开的外部页面获得原窗口控制权，可反向导航至钓鱼页，形成反向标签劫持。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is older browsers passing opener by default for blank-target links: the opened external page gains control of the original window and can reverse-navigate it to a phishing page, forming reverse tabnabbing.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步部署含四种 rel 组合链接的对照页并逐一打开，在每个新标签页检查 window.opener 是否可用：保留引用的组合即存在反向劫持风险，同时与当前浏览器隐式 noopener 基线对照记录版本差异。成功判据以 opener 可用性矩阵为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, deploy a comparison page with the four rel-combination links and open each, checking window.opener availability in every new tab; combos retaining the reference carry reverse-hijack risk, and compare against the current browser's implicit-noopener baseline for version differences. Judge success by the opener-availability matrix. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 全部外链显式添加 rel="noopener noreferrer"，出站跳转服务统一注入；对旧浏览器保留降级提示。修复后重放第 1 步，所有组合的 opener 均应为空。
mitigation.en: Explicitly add rel noopener noreferrer to all external links, injecting uniformly via the outbound-redirect service, with downgrade notices for legacy browsers. After the fix, replay step 1: opener should be null across all combos.

description.zh: 遍历站点页面与文章正文，收集指向外部域且带 target=_blank 的链接并记录各自 rel 属性组合；整理出候选入口后逐一进入检测阶段。
description.en: Crawl pages and article bodies for external target=_blank links, noting each rel combination; the inventory becomes the detection queue.

attackChain.payload: Click Click (safe) Click Click Click Click

title.zh: 检测 opener 引用是否保留

description.zh: 用第 1 步收集的 rel 组合打开外链并在新页面检查 window.opener；保留 opener 引用且未显式隔离的链接即存在反向 tabnabbing 条件。
description.en: Open links with each collected rel combo and inspect window.opener in the new tab; a surviving reference without explicit isolation marks reversibly-nabbable links.

attackChain.payload: Click Click (safe) Click Click Click Click

title.en: Navigate the opener to a phishing page

description.zh: 在可控外页执行 opener.location 跳转到钓鱼域；原标签被静默替换为仿真登录页，等待受害者回访输入凭据即完成攻击闭环。
description.en: From the controlled page set opener.location to a phishing domain; the silently swapped tab harvests credentials when the victim returns.

attackChain.payload: Click Click (safe) Click Click Click Click

analysis.zh: 行 0 的 `rel=opener` 是现代浏览器中的显式 opt-in 候选；行 1、4 使用 noopener，行 5 的 noreferrer 蕴含 noopener；行 2、3 虽无 noopener，但现代 `_blank` 仍隐式隔离，只有旧浏览器可作为兼容性例外。新标签打开成功不是 reverse tabnabbing 阳性。
analysis.en: Line 0 with `rel=opener` is the explicit modern opt-in candidate; lines 1 and 4 use noopener, and noreferrer on line 5 implies noopener. Lines 2 and 3 omit it but modern `_blank` still isolates implicitly, with legacy browsers only as compatibility exceptions. A successfully opened tab is not a reverse-tabnabbing finding.

opsecTips.zh: 目标页首次确认 opener 非空后停止，只执行跳转到本地无害标记页，不展示登录表单或采集导航数据。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the destination first confirms a non-null opener and navigate only to a local harmless marker page; do not display login forms or collect navigation data.

opsecTips.zh: 关闭所有测试标签，清理站点数据与 service worker，恢复 COOP/响应头并删除目标页的临时 opener 日志。
opsecTips.en: Close all test tabs, clear site data and service workers, restore COOP and response headers, and delete temporary opener logs on the destination.

review.rationale: 这是浏览上下文隔离/Tabnabbing 正负对照，不是 XSS。

lineSemantics.note: rel=opener explicitly requests an opener when COOP and browser policy permit it.
noopener and noreferrer suppress opener access.
nofollow does not request opener; target=_blank is implicitly noopener in modern browsers.
external does not request opener; target=_blank is implicitly noopener in modern browsers.
noopener suppresses opener access.
noreferrer also implies noopener.

wafBypass.command: // 注入在目标页：无 noopener 地打开新窗

description.zh: 绕过对 a 标签 rel 属性扫描：用 window.open 打开新窗且特性串不含 noopener，再由被打开的页面反向操控自身 opener；原标签页被导航到攻击域即成功。
description.en: Open via JS and control the opener in reverse past anchor rel scanning; the original tab navigating to the attacker domain confirms success.

description.zh: 表单 target 属性同样创建新上下文且无 rel 保护；提交后新页 opener 仍指向原页即成功。
description.en: A form target also creates a new browsing context without rel protection; after submission the new page's opener still referencing the original confirms success.

description.zh: 利用旧浏览器仅实现 noreferrer 不隐含 noopener 的兼容差异；新页可访问 window.opener 即成功。
description.en: Exploit older browsers implementing noreferrer without the implicit noopener; the new page reaching window.opener confirms success.

wafBypass.command: <form action="https://{ATTACKER_HOST}" target="_blank"><input type="image" src="play-button.png" alt="播放"></form>

description.zh: 以图像提交控件（input type=image）替代普通提交按钮并保留表单 _blank 打开行为；提交后新页持有 opener 引用即成功（现代浏览器对表单 _blank 的隐式 noopener 需实测核对）。
description.en: Replace the area with an image-submit control preserving _blank behavior; the new page holding an opener reference after submission confirms success.

description.zh: 链接 target 指向命名框架替代 _blank：导航已有上下文更难被 rel 规则约束；框架被替换为攻击页即成功。
description.en: Target a named frame instead of _blank, evading rel-oriented rules; the frame being replaced with the attacker page confirms success.

wafBypass.command: <map name="m"><area id="a" shape="rect" coords="0,0,200,60" href="about:blank" alt="next"></map>

description.zh: 静态扫描时无 target 属性：点击瞬间动态注入 _blank 与真实地址；新开页面保留 opener 即成功。
description.en: Inject target and href at click time so static scans see neither; the newly opened page retaining opener confirms success.

description.zh: 点击图像映射 area 链接打开新上下文；新页面保留 opener 即确认 area 目标的 opener 未隔离。
description.en: Click the image-map area link to open a new context; the new page retaining opener confirms unisolated opener on area targets.

title.zh: target=_blank 不同 rel 组合对照

execution.command: Click Click (safe) Click Click Click Click

description.zh: 用不同 rel 组合打开外链并检查 window.opener；保留 opener 引用的页面即存在反向 tabnabbing 风险。
description.en: Open the external links with different rel combinations and inspect window.opener; pages retaining the opener reference carry reverse-tabnabbing risk.

name.zh: 隐藏 iframe 与透明覆盖层探针
name.en: Hidden Iframe and Transparent Overlay Probes

description.zh: 区分不可交互的隐藏/零尺寸 iframe 与可覆盖页面的透明 iframe，验证嵌入内容和点击转移，而非错误称为 Tabnabbing。
description.en: Distinguishes noninteractive hidden or zero-size iframes from a transparent page-covering iframe to test embedding and click redirection rather than mislabeling it as tabnabbing.

prerequisites.zh: 页面允许插入 iframe，且 CSP frame-src、目标 X-Frame-Options/CSP frame-ancestors 与 sandbox 状态已记录。
prerequisites.en: The page permits iframe insertion and CSP frame-src, destination X-Frame-Options or frame-ancestors, and sandbox state are recorded.

prerequisites.zh: 目标 iframe 指向受控页面，页面仅记录是否加载及一次测试点击，不包含真实认证或敏感操作。
prerequisites.en: The iframe targets a controlled page that records only load state and one test click, with no real authentication or sensitive action.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 iframe 嵌入与透明覆盖的区分场景，检验隐藏帧的静默加载行为与覆盖式交互劫持的差异。验证维度为隐藏与零尺寸 iframe 的嵌入样例，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers distinguishing iframe embedding from transparent overlays, testing silent hidden-frame loading versus overlay-style interaction hijack. Validation embeds hidden and zero-size iframes in one sample, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于页面允许被任意 Frame 嵌入且缺安全头说明：隐藏 iframe 可静默加载外部内容消耗会话与配额，透明帧则可承载点击劫持，两者影响路径不同。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is pages allowing arbitrary frame embedding with no security headers: hidden iframes silently load external content consuming sessions and quotas, while transparent frames carry clickjacking, each with distinct impact paths.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步在对照页嵌入 display none 与零尺寸两类 iframe 指向外部测试页，打开页面后检查网络面板：请求出现且页面被静默加载即确认隐蔽嵌入路径，再记录响应 X-Frame-Options 以区分防护缺失层级。成功判据以网络面板请求记录为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, embed display-none and zero-size iframes pointing at an external test page on the comparison page, then inspect the network panel; requests appearing with the page silently loaded confirm the covert-embedding path, and record response X-Frame-Options to distinguish the missing protection layer. Judge success by network-panel request records. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 全站返回 X-Frame-Options 或 frame-ancestors 策略限定嵌入来源，对必须嵌入的场景用 CSP 限定具体父页面。修复后重放第 1 步，外部页面的 iframe 加载应被浏览器拦截。
mitigation.en: Serve site-wide X-Frame-Options or frame-ancestors policies limiting embedding origins, restricting specific parents via CSP where embedding is required. After the fix, replay step 1: the browser should block the external page's iframe load.

title.zh: 嵌入隐藏 iframe 建立加载通道
title.en: Embed hidden iframes as a load channel

description.zh: 在可控页面用 display:none 与零尺寸 iframe 静默加载外部地址；网络面板出现请求且页面无可见变化即建立隐蔽加载路径。
description.en: Load external URLs in display:none and zero-size iframes; requests appearing in the network panel with no visible change establish the covert channel.

description.zh: 把透明全页 iframe 叠放在目标控件之上形成 UI 覆盖；用测试点击验证事件被 iframe 接收即完成点击劫持的布局准备。
description.en: Stack a transparent full-page iframe over target controls; test clicks landing inside the iframe confirm the UI-redressing layout.

title.en: Bait the click to complete the hijack

description.zh: 把覆盖层对准登录表单或转账按钮等关键控件，诱导受害者在不知情下操作；动作在真实目标站生效即完成点击劫持攻击。
description.en: Align the overlay with login or transfer buttons and lure the victim; the action executing on the real site completes the clickjacking attack.

attackChain.payload: <iframe srcdoc="<script>setTimeout(function(){window.parent.location='https://{ATTACKER_HOST}/pwn'},2000)</script>" style="display:none"></iframe>

analysis.zh: 行 0 `display:none` 和行 1 零尺寸不会提供可点击表面，只能证明资源加载；行 2 的透明绝对定位覆盖需同时满足层级、尺寸与 pointer hit-testing 才可能是点击劫持。三者均没有 `_blank` 或 opener，因此不能报告 Tabnabbing。
analysis.en: Line 0 with display:none and line 1 at zero size provide no clickable surface and prove only loading. The transparent absolute overlay on line 2 is clickjacking only if stacking, dimensions, and pointer hit testing align. None has `_blank` or an opener, so none supports a tabnabbing report.

opsecTips.zh: 透明覆盖首次接收到测试点击后停止，不覆盖真实支付、管理或登录控件，也不诱导其他用户操作。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the transparent overlay receives one test click; do not cover real payment, administration, or login controls or involve other users.

opsecTips.zh: 删除测试 iframe 与 CSS，清理受控目标的点击日志，关闭页面并恢复 CSP/frame-ancestors 配置。
opsecTips.en: Remove the test iframe and CSS, clear controlled-target click logs, close the page, and restore CSP or frame-ancestors configuration.

review.rationale: 内容测试 iframe 嵌入/透明覆盖，不包含 opener，不能归 XSS 或 Tabnabbing。

lineSemantics.note: display:none removes the iframe from interaction.
zero dimensions provide no practical click target.
a transparent full-page iframe can be a UI-redress surface only if it receives pointer events above real controls.

description.zh: 绕过渲染初期即快照的检测：惰性加载推迟请求与执行；加载后隐藏框架行为生效即成功。
description.en: Defer the request and execution past early-snapshot detection via lazy loading; the hidden frame becoming active after load confirms success.

description.zh: 外联 src 特征被过滤时改用内联文档：实体编码脚本随框架解析执行，srcdoc 与父页同源、可直接改写 window.parent；父页面被导航到攻击域即成功。
description.en: Inline the document when external src signatures are filtered; the entity-encoded script executing and redirecting the opener confirms success.

description.zh: 初始隐藏待窗口失焦后全屏翻转：绕过常驻全屏框架检测；失焦后伪造页呈现即成功。
description.en: Hide initially and flip fullscreen on window blur, defeating persistent-fullframe detection; the spoofed page presenting after blur confirms success.

title.zh: 隐藏与零尺寸 iframe 嵌入探针

description.zh: 嵌入隐藏 iframe 加载外部页；请求在网络面板出现且页面被静默加载，即确认隐蔽加载路径。
description.en: Embed hidden iframes loading the external page; the requests appearing in the network panel with silent loading confirms the covert-loading path.

name.zh: 图像映射 area 的 _blank 隔离对照

description.zh: 使用 area 元素打开新浏览上下文，验证现代浏览器对 target=_blank 的隐式 noopener；该片段本身不是 XSS。
description.en: Uses an area element to open a new browsing context and verify modern implicit noopener for target=_blank; the snippet itself is not XSS.

prerequisites.zh: 完整 map/area/img 片段在当前浏览器可点击，图像与目标页均由授权测试环境托管。
prerequisites.en: The complete map, area, and img snippet is clickable in the current browser, and both image and destination are hosted in the authorized test environment.

prerequisites.zh: 记录浏览器版本、COOP 与目标页 opener 布尔值，不依赖肉眼判断新标签页。
prerequisites.en: Record browser version, COOP, and the destination's opener Boolean rather than visually inferring behavior from a new tab.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖图像映射 area 链接的 opener 隔离场景，检验新浏览上下文对原窗口引用的保留行为。验证维度为 area 元素 target 空白打开的对照样例，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers opener isolation for image-map area links, testing whether new browsing contexts keep references to the original window. Validation opens a blank-target area element as a comparison sample, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于旧浏览器未对 area 元素应用隐式 noopener：点击图像映射打开的外部页保留 opener，可反向控制原页面导航，风险与常规链接一致。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is legacy browsers not applying implicit noopener to area elements: external pages opened via image maps keep opener and can reverse-control the original page, matching regular-link risk.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步部署含 area 映射的对照页，点击映射区域打开外部测试页，在新窗口检查 window.opener 可用性并尝试反向导航原窗口：引用保留且导航成功即确认隔离缺失。成功判据以 opener 状态与导航结果为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；同时记录浏览器版本差异。
exploitation.en: In step 1, deploy a comparison page with an area map, click the mapped region to open an external test page, then check window.opener availability in the new window and attempt reverse navigation of the original; a retained reference with successful navigation confirms missing isolation. Judge success by opener state and navigation outcome. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; record browser version differences as well.

mitigation.zh: area 与 a 链接统一添加 rel 等于 noopener noreferrer，出站链接经统一跳转服务处理。修复后重放第 1 步，新窗口的 opener 应为空且反向导航失效。
mitigation.en: Add rel noopener noreferrer uniformly to area and anchor links, routing outbound links through one redirect service. After the fix, replay step 1: the new window's opener should be null and reverse navigation fail.

description.zh: 在可控页面用 map 与 area 把图片热区指向外链并设 target=_blank；点击热区即触发新浏览上下文，与普通链接共用同一套打开逻辑。
description.en: Wire an image map whose area targets an external link with target=_blank; clicking the hotspot opens a new context sharing the same link machinery.

title.zh: 检测热区链接的 opener 状态

description.zh: 在新开页面检查 window.opener 的取值；旧实现或显式 rel=opener 的场景下引用非空，即 area 热区同样可被反向利用。
description.en: Inspect window.opener in the opened page; on legacy engines or explicit rel=opener the reference is non-null, so the hotspot is reversibly exploitable.

description.zh: 子页通过 opener.location 把原页面导航到钓鱼站；用户回到原标签看到伪造页面并在其中输入，凭据即被截获。
description.en: The child steers opener.location to a phishing clone; the user returning to the familiar tab types credentials straight into the fake.

analysis.zh: 该四行 HTML 是一个完整图像映射，而不是四个独立 Payload。`area target=_blank` 在现代 HTML 行为下隐式 noopener，因此应作为兼容性负对照；仅打开新标签页、图片可点击或 href 导航成功都不是 reverse tabnabbing。
analysis.en: The four HTML lines form one image map rather than four independent payloads. An `area target=_blank` has implicit noopener in modern HTML behavior and is therefore a compatibility negative control; a new tab, clickable image, or successful href navigation is not reverse tabnabbing.

opsecTips.zh: 完成一次受控点击并确认 opener 状态后停止，不把 area 指向钓鱼页或真实业务页面。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one controlled click confirms opener state and do not point the area to phishing or real business pages.

opsecTips.zh: 删除 map/area 测试片段、图片和目标页日志，关闭新标签并清除站点存储。
opsecTips.en: Delete the map and area snippet, image, and destination logs, close the new tab, and clear site storage.

review.rationale: 现代 area `_blank` 是 opener 隔离负对照，属于浏览上下文安全而非 XSS。

wafBypass.command: <form action="https://{ATTACKER_HOST}" target="_blank"><input type="image" src="play-button.png" alt="播放"></form>

description.zh: 以图像提交控件替代 area 元素且保留 _blank 行为；提交后新页持有 opener 引用即成功。
description.en: Replace the area with an image-submit control preserving _blank behavior; the new page holding an opener reference after submission confirms success.

description.zh: 链接 target 指向命名框架替代 _blank：导航已有上下文更难被 rel 规则约束；框架被替换为攻击页即成功。
description.en: Target a named frame instead of _blank, evading rel-oriented rules; the frame being replaced with the attacker page confirms success.

description.zh: 静态扫描时无 target 属性：点击瞬间动态注入 _blank 与真实地址；新开页面保留 opener 即成功。
description.en: Inject target and href at click time so static scans see neither; the newly opened page retaining opener confirms success.

name.zh: WebSocket 消息 DOM XSS 探针

description.zh: 在 type=message 与 action=sendMessage 两种 JSON 信封中放置 HTML 事件处理器，验证 WebSocket 消息是否进入不安全 DOM sink。
description.en: Places HTML event-handler strings in type=message and action=sendMessage JSON envelopes to test whether WebSocket content reaches an unsafe DOM sink.

prerequisites.zh: 已确认应用接受其中一种 JSON 信封，并能定位消息从 WebSocket 处理器到 DOM 渲染 API 的数据流。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the application accepts one JSON envelope and trace data from the WebSocket handler to the DOM rendering API.

prerequisites.zh: 测试浏览器使用隔离账号与 CSP/控制台日志，执行标记只设置本地布尔值，不调用外部网络。
prerequisites.en: Use an isolated account with CSP and console logging, and make the execution marker set only a local Boolean without external network calls.

overview.zh: 覆盖 WebSocket 消息到 DOM sink 的注入验证：在 type=message 与 action=sendMessage 两种 JSON 信封中放置 HTML 事件处理器，验证前端把消息写入 DOM 后是否执行。
overview.en: Covers injection verification from WebSocket messages to DOM sinks: placing HTML event handlers inside both type=message and action=sendMessage JSON envelopes, testing whether the frontend executes after writing messages into the DOM.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是服务端或客户端把消息内容作为 HTML 写入 innerHTML 等 sink，未按 HTML 上下文编码或消毒；WebSocket 传输层不提供自动防护，风险落到实际浏览上下文。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is servers or clients writing message content as HTML into sinks like innerHTML without HTML-context encoding or sanitization; the WebSocket transport offers no automatic protection, so risk lands in the actual browsing context.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令经 WebSocket 两种消息格式注入事件载荷标签；前端把消息写入 DOM 后执行即确认 WS 消息到 DOM Sink 可达。先发送纯文本标记确认字段映射，再选择与实际 sink 匹配的无网络事件载荷并与转义文本对照，用 DevTools 证明执行来源为该 WebSocket 数据。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to inject event-payload tags through both WebSocket message formats; frontend execution after the message enters the DOM confirms WS-message reachability to the DOM sink. Send a plain-text marker confirming field mapping first, then choose a network-free event payload matching the actual sink contrasted against escaped text, proving via DevTools that execution originates from the WebSocket data.

mitigation.zh: 对消息 schema 严格验证，默认使用 textContent，富文本经维护的消毒器与 CSP 处理，存储与回放路径一致编码；修复后重放对照应保留合法功能且解析差异消失。
mitigation.en: Strictly validate message schemas, default to textContent, run rich text through maintained sanitizers with CSP, and encode consistently across storage and replay paths; after the fix, replaying controls must preserve legitimate functionality with parsing differentials gone.

title.zh: 消息通道提交标签载荷
title.en: Submit tag payloads over the message channel

description.zh: 向消息内容字段提交三类基础标签载荷，观察服务端广播与前端渲染路径是否原样输出执行，定位可注入落点，落点随即确定。
description.en: Push script, img and svg tags into the message content field and watch whether broadcast and render pass them through raw.

title.zh: 确认渲染进 DOM 触发执行
title.en: Confirm DOM rendering executes the payload

description.zh: 消息被插入聊天或通知区域后弹窗触发，即确认通道数据未净化直入页面，注入点与执行点同时成立可用推进，利用随即展开。
description.en: Once the message lands in the chat or feed area and alerts, the unfiltered WS-to-DOM path is confirmed end to end.

description.zh: 把载荷换成 Cookie 与令牌外带脚本，受害者每次打开消息页即触发回连，收集会话材料冒充其身份操作。
description.en: Swap in cookie/token beacon scripts; every victim page open fires a callback, harvesting session material for impersonation.

analysis.zh: 两组字段名只是到达 sink 的不同业务信封；是否 XSS 取决于最终 HTML 解析，而不是 WebSocket 帧被接受。`alert(1)` 字样出现在聊天记录、服务器 JSON 或日志中是假阳性；必须看到浏览器执行并排除扩展注入。
analysis.en: The two field families are business envelopes to the same class of sink; XSS depends on final HTML parsing, not acceptance of a WebSocket frame. `alert(1)` appearing in chat history, server JSON, or logs is false positive; browser execution must be observed after excluding extensions.

opsecTips.zh: 首个本地布尔标记执行后停止，不测试 Cookie 读取、外部 fetch、持久消息批量传播或其他用户账号。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the first local Boolean marker executes; do not test cookie reads, external fetches, bulk persistent propagation, or other users.

opsecTips.zh: 删除测试消息和存储记录，清理浏览器缓存/service worker，关闭套接字并确认没有重连队列继续回放载荷。
opsecTips.en: Delete test messages and stored records, clear browser cache and service workers, close the socket, and verify no reconnect queue replays the payload.

review.rationale: 消息内容是 XSS sink 探针，应保留在 XSS 分类并与协议握手问题分离。

description.zh: 绕过 script 消息过滤：图片事件执行。判据：消息渲染即弹窗。
description.en: img event payload in the WS message. Success: prompt on render.

description.zh: svg 事件在富文本容器执行。判据：触发弹窗。
description.en: svg event in the rich-text container. Success: alert.

description.zh: 服务端解码一次客户端再解码导致执行。判据：二次渲染后执行。
description.en: Decoded twice across server and client. Success: executes on second render.

description.zh: 需要用户交互，绕过自动执行检测。判据：悬停弹窗。
description.en: Needs interaction to fire. Success: alert on hover.

name.zh: WebSocket 消息到 OS 命令注入

description.zh: 在两种 WebSocket JSON 信封的内容字段中放置 Shell 分隔符与命令，验证后端是否把消息拼入操作系统命令。
description.en: Places shell separators and commands in two WebSocket JSON envelope fields to test whether the backend concatenates message content into an operating-system command.

prerequisites.zh: 已确认消息由服务器处理而非仅客户端渲染，并能观察 WebSocket 请求到后端子进程的父子关系。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the server processes the message rather than only rendering it client-side, and observe parentage from the WebSocket request to backend child processes.

prerequisites.zh: 将原始 id/whoami/cat/ls 替换为只输出唯一令牌的无害命令，测试账号无文件和网络高权限。
prerequisites.en: Replace source id, whoami, cat, and ls commands with a harmless unique-token command, and use an account without privileged file or network access.

overview.zh: WebSocket 消息到 OS 命令注入针对后端把 WebSocket 消息拼入操作系统命令的场景：两种 JSON 信封的内容字段覆盖 |、;、||、&& 分隔符。验证消息注入后的响应与后续页面输出。
overview.en: WebSocket message-to-OS command injection targets backends splicing WebSocket messages into OS commands: two JSON envelope content fields cover the |, ;, ||, and && separators. It validates response and downstream page output after message injection.

vulnerability.zh: WebSocket 消息内容被拼入 Shell 字符串或 shell=true 子进程，分隔符因此改变后端命令结构；风险必须落到实际消息 sink、认证主体或后端资源，不能从字符串外观推断。
vulnerability.en: WebSocket message content is spliced into shell strings or shell=true child processes, letting separators change backend command structure; risk must rest on the actual message sink, authenticated principal, or backend resources—string appearance alone proves nothing.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步在 WebSocket 连接上逐条发送 {"type":"message","content":"|id"} 等信封样例，覆盖 |、;、||、&& 分隔符与 id/whoami 等命令；命中判据为 WebSocket 响应或后续页面内容出现命令输出。逐条记录信封格式、响应帧与会话状态，区分消息回显与命令输出；确认可控后以读取标记文件的无害命令取证。
exploitation.en: Per step 1, send {"type":"message","content":"|id"} and similar envelope samples over the WebSocket connection one by one, covering |, ;, ||, and && separators with id/whoami-style commands; a hit is command output in the WebSocket response or downstream page content. Record envelope format, response frames, and session state per sample, distinguishing message echo from command output; after confirming control, gather evidence with harmless marker-file reads.

mitigation.zh: 使用固定程序与 argv，不将消息送入 Shell；对 schema、类型和枚举动作严格允许列表，并限制 worker 子进程权限。修复后重放相同对照，合法 WebSocket 功能应保留，越权能力或解析差异应消失。
mitigation.en: Use fixed programs with argv and never feed messages into shells; strictly allowlist schemas, types, and enumerated actions, and restrict worker child-process permissions. After the fix, replay the same contrasts—legitimate WebSocket features persist while privilege escalation or parsing differences disappear.

title.zh: 建立连接摸清消息格式
title.en: Connect and learn the message format

description.zh: 连接 WebSocket 观察消息信封与字段结构，确定可注入的字段。命中判据：消息结构可以被构造复现。
description.en: Connect and study the envelope/fields to find injectable spots. Success: messages can be crafted.

description.zh: 在 content 字段提交竖线与分号前缀的命令消息。命中判据：响应或后续页面出现命令输出，为下一步利用保留完整的输出内容。
description.en: Send messages whose content leads with | or ; commands. Success: output appears in responses.

description.zh: 换 type 与 action 信封及 ||、&& 组合扩大命中面。命中判据：更多组合可以触发命令执行。
description.en: Rotate envelopes and ||/&& combos to widen coverage. Success: more combos trigger execution.

description.zh: 把命令输出经 DNS 或 HTTP 通道外带并集中收集。命中判据：接收端收到外带的数据，同时排除缓存或随机因素干扰。
description.en: Push command output out over DNS or HTTP. Success: the collector receives it.

analysis.zh: 该条的危险边界位于 WebSocket 消息消费者到 OS Shell，而非浏览器。每个原始命令都可能读取主机信息或文件，验证时不得直接运行；只有进程树与唯一标记可确认 RCE，消息 ACK、断连或过滤器告警均不能。
analysis.en: The dangerous boundary is between the WebSocket consumer and an OS shell, not the browser. Every source command could expose host or file data and must not be run for validation; only process ancestry and a unique marker confirm RCE, while acknowledgments, disconnects, or filter alerts do not.

opsecTips.zh: 首次生成受控标记子进程后停止，不继续执行 whoami、读取 `/flag`、列目录或建立反向连接。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the first controlled marker child process and do not continue with whoami, `/flag` reads, directory listing, or reverse connections.

opsecTips.zh: 终止测试 worker/子进程，删除标记和消息记录，关闭 WebSocket 并确认自动重连不会再次发送命令。
opsecTips.en: Terminate test workers and child processes, delete markers and message records, close the WebSocket, and verify automatic reconnect does not resend commands.

review.rationale: 这是 WebSocket 到后端 Shell 的 RCE Payload，不能挂在 XSS。

description.zh: 换行符消息变体 — 绕过对 | ; 等分隔符的 WS 消息过滤：在 content 中注入真实换行符（JSON \n）触发后端 shell 换行执行；若后端对消息内容先做 URL 解码，也可改用 %0A 形式。成功判据：返回 uid/gid 信息。
description.en: Bypasses WS message filters blocking | and ; by using %0A so the backend shell executes a new line. Success: uid/gid info returned.

description.zh: 绕过分隔符特征：$() 命令替换不依赖管道或分号；成功判据：消息回显中含 id 输出。
description.en: Avoids separator signatures since $() needs no pipe or semicolon. Success: id output appears in the reply message.

description.zh: $IFS 代替空格并读取 flag，规避空格+路径组合规则；成功判据：flag 出现在回包。
description.en: Uses $IFS for whitespace while reading the flag, evading space+path rules. Success: flag appears in the response.

title.en: Validation step 1 for WebSocket Message-to-OS Command Injection

description.zh: WebSocket命令注入包含多个可复现输入样例；应逐条测试并记录响应与日志差异。命中判据：WebSocket 响应或后续页面内容出现命令输出。
description.en: Run this WebSocket Message-to-OS Command Injection validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline. Success check: command output appears in the WebSocket response or subsequent page content.

name.zh: WebSocket 消息 SQL 注入

description.zh: 在 type/message 与 action/sendMessage 信封中测试布尔、UNION 和时间条件，验证消息字段是否拼入数据库查询。
description.en: Tests Boolean, UNION, and timing predicates in type/message and action/sendMessage envelopes to determine whether a message field is concatenated into a database query.

prerequisites.zh: 已确认 WebSocket 消息触发服务器数据库访问，并能关联消息 ID、最终参数化/拼接查询与数据库日志。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the WebSocket message triggers server-side database access and correlate message ID, final bound or concatenated query, and database logs.

prerequisites.zh: 使用隔离测试表和固定记录，时间探针延时缩短且有正常/恒假统计对照。
prerequisites.en: Use an isolated test table with fixed rows and short timing probes with normal and false statistical controls.

overview.zh: 覆盖 WebSocket 消息字段的 SQL 注入验证：在 type/message 与 action/sendMessage 信封中测试布尔、UNION 与时间条件，确认消息字段是否拼入数据库查询。
overview.en: Covers SQL injection verification over WebSocket message fields: testing boolean, UNION, and timing conditions inside type/message and action/sendMessage envelopes to confirm whether message fields are concatenated into database queries.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是消息字段未经类型约束与参数绑定就拼入 SQL，WebSocket 传输层不自动提供数据库安全；判定标准是查询结果、数据库审计或统计延时与条件对应。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is message fields concatenated into SQL without type constraints or parameter binding — the WebSocket transport grants no automatic database safety; the decision standard is query results, database audit, or statistical latency corresponding to conditions.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令经 WebSocket 以两种消息格式发送恒真、UNION 与 SLEEP 注入；返回结果异常扩大或响应延迟约 3-5 秒即确认 WS 消息可达 SQL 拼接层。先用普通文本与真假条件比较固定记录，再按已识别 DBMS 选择一个 UNION 或短时间探针，避免混用方言。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to send always-true, UNION, and SLEEP injections through both WebSocket message formats; abnormally enlarged result sets or roughly 3-5 second response delays confirm WS messages reach the SQL concatenation layer. Compare fixed records with plain text and true/false conditions first, then pick one UNION or short timing probe per the identified DBMS, never mixing dialects.

mitigation.zh: 对消息 schema 做类型验证并使用预编译参数，动态标识符映射允许列表，限制数据库账户并统一错误；修复后重放对照应保留合法功能且注入无效。
mitigation.en: Type-validate message schemas with prepared-statement parameters, map dynamic identifiers via allowlists, restrict database accounts, and unify errors; after the fix, replaying controls must preserve legitimate functionality with injections inert.

title.zh: 消息字段提交布尔条件
title.en: Submit boolean conditions via WS messages

description.zh: 消息内容字段提交恒真与注释闭合语句，响应消息内容差异或数据库报错出现，即确认查询通道存在注入点，注入通道成立。
description.en: Push OR tautologies with comment closures in the content field; message deltas or SQL errors confirm an injectable query path.

title.zh: 联合查询变体深化注入
title.en: Deepen the injection with UNION variants

description.zh: 换联合查询空值占位递增对齐列数，消息返回中出现占位回显即结构对齐，为数据读取定位到输出位置，读取路线确定。
description.en: Grow UNION SELECT NULL padding; placeholders surfacing in the reply mean alignment is done and echo slots are located.

title.en: Chain into the DB-specific extraction flow

description.zh: 按识别出的数据库类型接入对应枚举语句，把表结构与口令数据经消息通道逐批带回控制端完成数据收割，数据陆续落地。
description.en: Attach the DB-appropriate enumeration statements and stream schema and credentials back through the WS channel in batches.

analysis.zh: type 与 action 信封只是到达查询 sink 的两种路由。只有恒真/恒假结果差异、列结构标记或可重复时间信号与最终 SQL 一致才是阳性；数据库返回语法错误、聊天内容包含引号或网关阻断都可能是假阳性。
analysis.en: The type and action envelopes are only routes to the query sink. Positive evidence requires true or false result differences, a reflected column marker, or repeatable timing aligned with final SQL; database syntax errors, quotes in chat content, or gateway blocking can all be false positives.

opsecTips.zh: 获得一个固定测试记录或短延时证据后停止，不读取用户表、系统目录或扩大时间/请求次数。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one fixed test-row or short-delay proof and do not read user tables or catalogs or increase timing and request volume.

opsecTips.zh: 删除测试消息与数据库标记行，结束连接，清理慢查询/审计中的敏感文本并确认无重试。
opsecTips.en: Delete test messages and marker rows, close the connection, sanitize sensitive text from slow-query or audit logs, and verify no retries remain.

review.rationale: 消息字段进入数据库查询，真实分类是 SQL 注入而非 XSS。

title.zh: JSON 字段 Unicode 转义

description.zh: 绕过对 WebSocket 帧内明文元字符的扫描：引号转义为 \u0027 由服务端解码；数据库报错或响应差异即成功。
description.en: Escape the quote inside the frame for server-side decoding past plaintext frame scanning; a database error or response delta confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对 UNION SELECT 全字匹配：消息内容注释分词加混合大小写；注入语句生效即成功。
description.en: Comment-split and case-mix inside the message content; an effective injected statement confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过按 type/content 小写键取值的检测逻辑：键名大小写变形测试后端匹配宽松度；消息仍被处理且注入生效即成功。
description.en: Mutate key case to test lenient backend matching of type/content keys; the message still handled with an effective injection confirms success.

title.en: Validation step 1 for WebSocket Message SQL Injection

description.zh: 经 WebSocket 以两种消息格式发送恒真、UNION 与 SLEEP 注入；返回结果异常扩大或响应延迟约 3-5 秒即确认 WS 消息可达 SQL 拼接层。
description.en: Send tautology, UNION, and SLEEP injections over WebSocket in both message formats; an abnormally enlarged result or a ~3-5 second delay confirms WS messages reach the SQL concatenation layer.

name.zh: 跨站 WebSocket 劫持的 Origin 校验
name.en: Origin Validation for Cross-Site WebSocket Hijacking

description.zh: 测试 WebSocket 握手是否严格校验浏览器 Origin，并确认跨站页面能否借自动携带的会话凭据建立有权限连接。
description.en: Tests strict Origin validation during a WebSocket handshake and whether a cross-site page can establish an authorized connection using automatically attached session credentials.

prerequisites.zh: 目标 WebSocket 使用 Cookie 或浏览器自动携带的凭据，测试账号与跨站测试源均受控。
prerequisites.en: The target WebSocket uses cookies or other browser-attached credentials, and both the test account and cross-site origin are controlled.

prerequisites.zh: 可记录实际浏览器发送的 Origin、握手状态、会话主体和一项无副作用授权动作。
prerequisites.en: Record the browser-generated Origin, handshake status, session principal, and one side-effect-free authorized action.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖跨站 WebSocket 劫持的 Origin 校验场景，检验握手对来源头的严格程度与凭据借用的可达性。验证维度为 null、拼接与控制字符 Origin 的绕过矩阵，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers CSWSH Origin validation, testing handshake strictness on source headers and reachability of credential borrowing. Validation is a bypass matrix of null, concatenated and control-character Origins, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于握手端点的 Origin 校验使用包含匹配或接受空值：跨站页面借浏览器自动附带的会话完成握手并读取推送数据，形成会话劫持。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is handshake Origin checks using containment matching or accepting null: cross-site pages complete handshakes on automatically attached sessions and read pushed data, achieving session hijack.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步按脚本把 Origin 绕过变体逐条置于握手请求发送并记录握手结果：任一跨站来源完成握手且收到消息即确认校验缺失，用合成 marker 验证消息可读性。成功判据以握手成功与消息接收为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, place Origin bypass variants into handshake requests one by one per the script, recording outcomes; any cross-site origin completing a handshake and receiving messages confirms missing validation, verified for message readability with synthetic markers. Judge success by handshake success and message reception. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 握手端点按预注册 Origin 白名单精确匹配并拒绝空值，敏感频道在消息层再校验会话权限。修复后重放第 1 步矩阵，全部绕过变体应握手失败。
mitigation.en: Handshake endpoints must exact-match pre-registered Origin allowlists rejecting null, with sensitive channels re-checking session permissions at the message layer. After the fix, replay the step 1 matrix: every bypass variant should fail its handshake.

description.zh: 抓包或阅读前端脚本找出 WS 握手地址，确认连接依赖 Cookie 会话；浏览器发起即自动携带凭据，具备跨站劫持的条件。
description.en: Find the WS handshake URL via traffic or front-end code and confirm cookie-based sessions; browser-initiated connections carry credentials automatically.

title.zh: 发送 Origin 绕过变体

description.zh: 用 null、子域拼接、Tab 与 NUL 及 CRLF 编码等 Origin 变体逐条发起握手；任一变体返回 101 并接受消息即绕过 Origin 校验。
description.en: Attempt handshakes with null, subdomain-joined, tab/NUL and CRLF-encoded Origin variants; any 101 that accepts messages defeats the Origin check.

title.zh: 跨站劫持 WS 会话

description.zh: 在攻击者页面借受害者会话上下文连接 WS 并调用受保护动作；以其身份收到数据或触发操作即完成跨站 WebSocket 劫持。
description.en: From the attacker page open the WS under the victim's session and invoke protected actions; data or side effects under their identity complete the CSWSH.

analysis.zh: `Origin: null` 可能来自 sandbox/file 环境但不应默认信任；相似域、编码斜杠、反斜杠、端口和空 Origin 用于发现错误字符串匹配。只有浏览器可产生的恶意 Origin 在携带测试会话时获授权才是 CSWSH，手工客户端可设置任意头会产生假阳性。
analysis.en: `Origin: null` can arise from sandbox or file contexts but should not be trusted by default. Lookalike domains, encoded slashes, backslashes, ports, and empty Origin probe flawed string matching. CSWSH requires a browser-producible hostile Origin to gain authorization with the test session; arbitrary headers from a manual client create false positives.

opsecTips.zh: 跨站页面首次读取一项无敏感标记后停止，不发送状态修改消息、导出聊天记录或使用他人会话。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the cross-site page reads one nonsensitive marker and do not send state-changing messages, export chat history, or use another user's session.

opsecTips.zh: 注销测试会话，关闭两端 WebSocket，删除跨站页面与消息，清理 Cookie、站点数据和握手日志中的令牌。
opsecTips.en: Log out the test session, close both sockets, delete the cross-site page and messages, and clear cookies, site data, and tokens from handshake logs.

review.rationale: CSWSH 是会话型跨站请求伪造/授权问题，不是 XSS。

title.zh: Origin 头名大小写与空白变形
title.en: Origin header-name case and whitespace variants

description.zh: 绕过以 "^Origin: https://白名单" 之类正则做 CSWSH 防护的规则：头名小写/全大写、冒号后双空格、制表符与无空格形态语义等价而签名不同；成功判据：变形 Origin 下握手仍返回 101。
description.en: Bypasses CSWSH rules built on regexes like "^Origin: https://allowlist": lowercase/all-caps header names and post-colon double-space, tab or no-space forms are semantically identical but signature-different; success criterion: the handshake still returns 101 under variant Origins.

title.zh: scheme 大小写与前导零端口

wafBypass.command:
Origin: HTTPS://{TARGET}
Origin: Https://{TARGET}:443
Origin: https://{TARGET}:0443
Origin: https://{TARGET}:443/
Origin: https://{TARGET}:443%2f

description.zh: 绕过大小写敏感或端口精确匹配的 Origin 白名单：scheme 混合大小写、前导零端口 0443、默认端口显式化与 %2f 编码路径在解析后同源；成功判据：变形 Origin 被接受并完成跨站 WS 通信。
description.en: Bypasses case-sensitive or exact-port Origin allowlists: mixed-case schemes, leading-zero port 0443, explicit default ports and %2f-encoded paths parse to the same origin; success criterion: a variant Origin is accepted and cross-site WS traffic completes.

title.zh: 尾点与 Unicode 点变形

description.zh: 绕过对完整 Origin 字符串的白名单比对：FQDN 尾点、%2E 编码点、全角句点 U+3002 及其 UTF-8 编码在 URL/域名归一化后等价；成功判据：变形 Origin 通过校验（101 或成功回显）。
description.en: Bypasses allowlists comparing the full Origin string: FQDN trailing dots, %2E-encoded dots, the fullwidth U+3002 and its UTF-8 encoding are equivalent after URL/domain normalization; success criterion: a variant Origin passes validation (101 or successful echo).

title.zh: null 值大小写与 userinfo 混淆

description.zh: null 值大小写与 userinfo 混淆 — 绕过对 "Origin: null" 全小写字面匹配和权威域后缀匹配的校验：NULL/Null 等大小写变体在服务端做小写归一后仍命中 null 放行规则（该规则本意是支持 sandboxed iframe），userinfo 形式 https://白名单@攻击域 让子串匹配通过而真实 authority 是攻击域；成功判据：变形 Origin 下 101 握手成功。
description.en: Bypasses the all-lowercase "Origin: null" literal and suffix matching on the authority: NULL/Null case variants still trigger sandboxed-frame allow logic, while userinfo forms like https://allowlisted@attacker pass substring checks with the real authority being the attacker host; success criterion: 101 handshake succeeds under variant Origins.

title.en: Validation step 1 for Origin Validation for Cross-Site WebSocket Hijacking

description.zh: 把 Origin 绕过变体逐条置于 WebSocket 握手；跨站页面完成握手并收到消息，即确认 CSWSH Origin 校验缺失。
description.en: Place each Origin-bypass variant into the WebSocket handshake; a cross-site page completing the handshake and receiving messages confirms missing CSWSH Origin validation.

name.zh: WebSocket 握手 Host 与 Origin 路由校验
name.en: WebSocket Handshake Host and Origin Routing Validation

description.zh: 向 WebSocket 握手发送 Host 头变体，验证虚拟主机路由与端口暴露面。
description.en: Send Host header variants to the WebSocket handshake to verify virtual-host routing and port exposure.

prerequisites.zh: 已记录反向代理、负载均衡器和应用各自处理 Host/Origin 的规则与允许端口。
prerequisites.en: Record how the reverse proxy, load balancer, and application process Host and Origin and which ports are allowed.

prerequisites.zh: 使用受控虚拟主机和测试账号，可关联外层 HTTP Upgrade 与最终 WebSocket 服务实例。
prerequisites.en: Use a controlled virtual host and test account and correlate the outer HTTP Upgrade with the final WebSocket service instance.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 WebSocket 握手阶段的 Host 与 Origin 路由校验场景，检验虚拟主机选择与来源策略的一致性。验证维度为端口、拼接主机与旧式来源头的变体矩阵，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers handshake-stage Host and Origin routing validation for WebSockets, testing consistency between vhost selection and source policy. Validation is a variant matrix of ports, concatenated hosts and legacy source headers, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于握手路由信任 Host 与旧式来源头而缺少白名单：变体写法让请求命中非预期虚拟主机或绕过来源策略，握手照常建立。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is handshake routing trusting Host and legacy source headers without allowlists: variant spellings land requests on unintended vhosts or bypass source policy, and handshakes still establish.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步按脚本把 Host 与来源头变体逐条置于握手请求发送并记录路由选择与握手结果：任一变体命中非预期虚拟主机或绕过来源策略仍完成握手即确认校验缺陷。成功判据以握手成功矩阵为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, place Host and source-header variants into handshake requests one by one per the script, recording routing choices and handshake outcomes; any variant landing on unintended vhosts or completing handshakes despite source policy confirms the validation defect. Judge success by the handshake-success matrix. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 握手端点固定虚拟主机选择并校验 Host 白名单，来源策略统一基于标准 Origin 头。修复后重放第 1 步矩阵，全部变体应被路由拒绝或握手 403。
mitigation.en: Pin vhost selection with Host allowlist checks at handshake endpoints, unifying source policy on the standard Origin header. After the fix, replay the step 1 matrix: every variant should be route-refused or handshake-403.

description.zh: 记录正常 WS 握手的 Host 与 Origin 头及路由落点；确认代理按 Host 分发即锁定可篡改的路由字段，作为后续攻击目标。
description.en: Record Host/Origin on a normal handshake and where it lands; proxy-by-Host routing marks the field to tamper with.

title.zh: 篡改 Host 与旧式头

description.zh: 逐条注入端口变体、域拼接、Host 置 null 与已废弃的 Sec-WebSocket-Origin 头；任一变体完成握手即确认路由校验存在缺陷。
description.en: Inject port variants, domain joins, Host: null and the deprecated Sec-WebSocket-Origin one by one; any completed handshake exposes the routing flaw.

title.zh: 劫持握手到非预期服务
title.en: Route the handshake to the wrong service

description.zh: 把握手路由到内部或相邻虚拟主机并在该上下文建立会话；获得本不该有的消息权限即完成 WebSocket 握手路由劫持。
description.en: Steer the handshake to an internal or sibling vhost and establish the session there; message permissions you should never have complete the hijack.

analysis.zh: Host 控制连接路由，Origin 表示脚本来源；`Sec-WebSocket-Origin` 来自早期草案且不应作为现代安全信号。手工客户端可以伪造这些头，所以只有跨层解析差异导致错误服务和权限才是阳性；单一头被接受或端口响应不同是假阳性。
analysis.en: Host controls connection routing while Origin represents script origin; `Sec-WebSocket-Origin` is from an early draft and should not be a modern security signal. Manual clients can forge these headers, so only cross-layer parsing that reaches the wrong service and privilege is positive; acceptance of one header or different port responses is false positive.

opsecTips.zh: 首次确认路由到受控错误虚拟主机后停止，不连接生产后台、管理端口或其他租户。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the first controlled misrouting to a test virtual host and do not connect to production backends, management ports, or other tenants.

opsecTips.zh: 关闭测试套接字，恢复代理 Host 映射和证书配置，删除握手样例并清空连接池。
opsecTips.en: Close test sockets, restore proxy Host mappings and certificate configuration, delete handshake samples, and drain connection pools.

review.rationale: 这是 HTTP Upgrade/虚拟主机握手安全，真实分类为 API/WebSocket 协议而非 XSS。

description.zh: 绕过握手路由层对 Host 精确匹配的校验：尾点、%2E 编码点、端口后尾点、前导零端口与全角句点在归一化后等价；成功判据：变形 Host 仍路由到 WS 服务并返回 101。
description.en: Bypasses exact Host matching at the handshake routing layer: trailing dots, %2E encoding, dot after port, leading-zero port and fullwidth dot normalize equivalently; success criterion: variant Hosts still route to the WS service and return 101.

title.zh: 重复 Host 与列表形态

description.zh: 绕过单 Host 校验缺失的代理链：先发合规 Host 再发第二 Host 或逗号/分号列表，前置层与后端各取其一；成功判据：握手完成且路由到了目标 WS 后端（101 而非 400）。
description.en: Bypasses proxy chains lacking duplicate-Host validation: send the compliant Host first plus a second Host or comma/semicolon list so the front and back ends pick different values; success criterion: the handshake completes routed to the target WS backend (101, not 400).

description.zh: 绕过只看 Host 头的握手路由校验：反代后端优先采用 X-Forwarded-Host/X-Original-Host/X-Host/Forwarded 决定虚拟主机；成功判据：带转发头的握手请求命中目标 WS 路由（101）。
description.en: Bypasses handshake routing that inspects only Host: backend tiers honoring X-Forwarded-Host/X-Original-Host/X-Host/Forwarded decide the vhost; success criterion: handshakes with forwarding headers hit the target WS route (101).

title.zh: 升级头大小写与版本协商

wafBypass.command:
Upgrade: WebSocket
UPGRADE: WEBSOCKET
Connection: keep-alive, Upgrade
Sec-WebSocket-Version: 8, 13
sec-websocket-version: 13

description.zh: 升级头大小写与连接令牌变形 — 绕过对 "Upgrade: websocket" 与 "Sec-WebSocket-Version: 13" 精确模板的检测：头值大小写、Connection 令牌顺序与头名小写在 HTTP 语义下等价；逗号分隔的多版本列表（"8, 13"）不是 RFC 6455 的标准请求形态，仅用于探测宽容解析的服务端；成功判据：变形握手仍返回 101 及所选版本。
description.en: Bypasses detection on the exact "Upgrade: websocket" and "Sec-WebSocket-Version: 13" templates: value case, connection token order, multi-version negotiation and lowercase header names parse equivalently under RFC 6455; success criterion: variant handshakes still return 101 with a selected version.

title.en: Validation step 1 for WebSocket Handshake Host and Origin Routing Validation

description.zh: 把 Host 与 Origin 握手变体逐条置于 WS 握手；任一变体完成握手，即确认握手路由校验缺陷。
description.en: Place each Host or Origin handshake variant into the WS handshake; any variant completing the handshake confirms handshake-routing validation flaws.

name.zh: WebSocket 富文本 XSS 上下文探针

description.zh: 覆盖 chat/send/message/data 四类消息信封（消息外层 JSON 结构）、交互事件、SVG/data URL 与高风险外传样例，验证 WebSocket 富文本内容在不同 DOM 上下文是否缺少编码。
description.en: Covers chat, send, message, and data envelopes plus interactive events, SVG, data URLs, and high-risk exfiltration samples to test context-specific encoding of WebSocket rich text.

prerequisites.zh: 已识别实际支持的消息 schema 与最终 HTML、属性、URL 或 SVG sink，其他信封仅作为负对照。
prerequisites.en: Identify the supported message schema and final HTML, attribute, URL, or SVG sink; treat unsupported envelopes as negative controls.

prerequisites.zh: 使用隔离账号，浏览器禁止访问外部网络；所有 alert/fetch/sendBeacon 原始动作用本地无害执行标记替代。
prerequisites.en: Use an isolated account and networkless browser and replace source alert, fetch, and sendBeacon actions with a harmless local execution marker.

overview.zh: 面向 WebSocket 富文本上下文的 XSS 验证：覆盖 chat/send/message/data 消息信封、交互事件、SVG/data URL 与 Cookie 外传形态，检验富文本内容在不同 DOM 上下文是否缺少编码。
overview.en: Covers XSS verification in WebSocket rich-text contexts: spanning chat/send/message/data envelopes, interaction events, SVG/data URLs, and cookie-exfiltration forms, testing missing encoding of rich text across DOM contexts.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是消息在存储、广播或客户端重放时进入与其编码不匹配的富文本 sink，允许事件属性、危险 URL 或 SVG 脚本执行；需按最终输出上下文选择样例而非批量投递。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is messages entering rich-text sinks mismatched with their encoding during storage, broadcast, or client replay, permitting event attributes, hazardous URLs, or SVG script execution; samples must be chosen per final output context rather than sprayed.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令经 WebSocket 注入富文本载荷与外发样例；消息被渲染为 HTML 后载荷执行，或 {ATTACKER_HOST}（指向本地隔离收集器）收到 cookie，即确认富文本上下文 XSS 成立。先用纯文本定位上下文，只选择一个无网络标记变体并与消毒/编码对照，分别观察发送端与接收端。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to inject rich-text contexts and exfiltration payloads via WebSocket; execution after formatted rendering or {ATTACKER_HOST} receiving cookies confirms rich-text context XSS, with {ATTACKER_HOST} rendered as an isolated collector. Locate the context with plain text first, choose a single network-free marker variant contrasted against sanitization/encoding, and observe sender and receiver sides separately.

mitigation.zh: 对每个字段执行 context-aware 编码，富文本采用严格允许列表消毒，拒绝 javascript/data 协议并部署无 unsafe-inline 的 CSP；修复后重放对照应保留合法功能且执行消失。
mitigation.en: Apply context-aware encoding per field, sanitize rich text with strict allowlists, reject javascript/data schemes, and deploy CSP without unsafe-inline; after the fix, replaying controls must preserve legitimate functionality with execution gone.

title.zh: 富文本上下文提交协议载荷
title.en: Submit scheme payloads into rich-text contexts

description.zh: 向富文本消息提交以 javascript: 伪协议作为 iframe 源的载荷，观察内容区是否按 HTML 渲染执行；命中即确认消息通道侧存在脚本注入。
description.en: Post iframe javascript: sources into rich-text messages; HTML-style rendering in the feed indicates WS-side XSS.

title.zh: 事件属性变体扩大命中

description.zh: 补充链接跳转与悬停等交互事件属性载荷，受害者交互时触发弹窗，确认多种标签上下文均可注入并执行攻击代码，攻击面随之扩大。
description.en: Add a-href and div onmouseover variants; hover-triggered alerts prove multiple tag contexts execute injected markup.

description.zh: 以可执行上下文为基础注入外带脚本或伪装输入框，窃取 Cookie 与输入内容，把消息通道变成攻击跳板。
description.en: With execution established, plant beacons or fake inputs to steal cookies and keystrokes, turning the feed into the attack pivot.

attackChain.payload: {"type":"message","content":"<details open ontoggle=alert(1)>"}

analysis.zh: 该集合含明显高风险 Cookie 外传与 data/SVG 变体，验证不需要实际外传。消息被广播或存储只是到达条件；必须在特定接收端 sink 中执行无害标记。被 CSP 阻止、DOMPurify 删除、客户端显示转义文本或只有发送者自我执行均是假阳性/影响边界。
analysis.en: The set contains high-risk cookie-exfiltration and data or SVG variants, but validation never requires exfiltration. Broadcast or storage is only reachability; a harmless marker must execute in the specific receiving sink. CSP blocking, sanitizer removal, escaped rendering, or sender-only self-execution defines false-positive or impact boundaries.

opsecTips.zh: 一个接收端上下文执行本地标记后停止，不使用原始 Cookie 外传、sendBeacon、data URL 或跨用户批量消息。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one receiver context executes the local marker; do not use source cookie exfiltration, sendBeacon, data URLs, or cross-user bulk messages.

opsecTips.zh: 删除所有测试消息和附件，清理接收端浏览器存储/service worker，关闭连接并检查持久队列不再广播。
opsecTips.en: Delete all test messages and attachments, clear receiver storage and service workers, close connections, and verify persistent queues no longer broadcast them.

review.rationale: 这是 WebSocket 富文本到浏览器 sink 的 XSS Payload，独立于 RCE/SQLi/握手问题。

description.zh: 媒体子元素错误事件。判据：加载失败弹窗。
description.en: Media child error event. Success: alert on failure.

description.zh: 冷门事件绕过黑名单。判据：渲染触发。
description.en: Rare event bypass. Success: fires on render.

description.zh: 导航式执行需一次点击。判据：点击弹窗。
description.en: Navigation-style payload. Success: alert on click.

description.zh: object 的 data 属性执行。判据：渲染执行。
description.en: object data attribute execution. Success: fires on render.

description.zh: 绕过 script 消息过滤：图片事件执行。判据：消息渲染即弹窗。
description.en: img event payload in the WS message. Success: prompt on render.

description.zh: svg 事件在富文本容器执行。判据：触发弹窗。
description.en: svg event in the rich-text container. Success: alert.

description.zh: 实体形式的载荷可绕过对 <、script 的黑名单检查；若服务端在入库或输出前把实体解码一次且渲染时未转义，还原出的标签即被执行。判据：实体被还原为标签并在二次渲染后执行。
description.en: Decoded twice across server and client. Success: executes on second render.

description.zh: 需要用户交互，绕过自动执行检测。判据：悬停弹窗。
description.en: Needs interaction to fire. Success: alert on hover.

title.en: Validation step 1 for WebSocket Message DOM-XSS Probes

description.zh: 经 WebSocket 两种消息格式注入事件载荷标签；前端把消息写入 DOM 后执行即确认 WS 消息到 DOM Sink 可达。
description.en: Inject event-payload tags over WebSocket in both message formats; execution after the client writes messages into the DOM confirms the WS-message-to-DOM-sink path.

title.en: Validation step 1 for WebSocket Rich-Text XSS Context Probes

description.zh: 经 WebSocket 向各消息信封注入富文本载荷与外发样例；消息被渲染为 HTML 后载荷执行，或 {ATTACKER_HOST} 收到 cookie（{ATTACKER_HOST} 指向本地隔离收集器，非真实外传），即确认富文本上下文 XSS 成立。
description.en: Inject rich-text context and exfil payloads over WebSocket; execution after formatted rendering or cookies arriving at {ATTACKER_HOST} confirms the rich-text XSS context. {ATTACKER_HOST} renders to the isolated collector.

name.zh: WebSocket 驱动的服务端请求伪造

description.zh: 通过 request/fetch/proxy/url/uri/endpoint 等消息字段请求回环、元数据、file 与 gopher 目标，验证 WebSocket 后端是否代发网络或文件请求。
description.en: Uses request, fetch, proxy, url, uri, and endpoint fields for loopback, metadata, file, and gopher targets to test whether a WebSocket backend performs network or file requests.

prerequisites.zh: 已确认某个消息动作会在服务器侧获取 URL，并能区分浏览器自身请求、后端 HTTP 客户端与命令字段执行。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that a message action fetches a URL server-side and distinguish browser requests, backend HTTP clients, and command-field execution.

prerequisites.zh: 部署受控外部与回环标记服务；file、gopher 与云元数据原始目标均替换为无敏感测试资源。
prerequisites.en: Deploy controlled external and loopback marker services and replace source file, gopher, and cloud-metadata targets with nonsensitive test resources.

overview.zh: WebSocket 驱动的服务端请求伪造覆盖 WS 消息调度场景：针对经 WebSocket 接收 request/fetch/proxy/url 等字段的后端，验证回环、元数据、file 与 gopher 目标能否被服务器代为访问。验证维度涵盖外部标记确认、逐字段测试与出站日志关联三类。
overview.en: WebSocket-Driven Server-Side Request Forgery covers WS-message dispatch: for backends accepting request/fetch/proxy/url fields over WebSocket, verify whether loopback, metadata, file, and gopher targets get fetched by the server. Verification dimensions cover external-marker confirmation, per-field testing, and egress-log correlation.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 WebSocket 消息中的 URL 或目标未经协议、解析后地址与重定向校验，worker 以服务器网络身份访问内部资源；command 字段若被 Shell 执行需另按 RCE 证据判断，风险必须落到实际消息 sink 与后端资源。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is URLs or targets inside WebSocket messages unvalidated for scheme, resolved address, or redirects while workers reach internal resources with the server's network identity; command fields executed by a shell must instead be judged under RCE evidence, and risk must land on actual message sinks and backend resources.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步先用外部标记确认后端会按消息发起请求；再选一个回环标记 URL 逐字段测试（type:request、fetch、proxy 等），阳性要求后端客户端/出站代理与目标服务记录同一令牌；含 file 或 gopher 的消息确认协议转发。不触碰元数据、真实文件或 Redis。WebSocket ACK、浏览器请求、连接超时或 command 字符串被存储都不够。占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 first confirms the backend fetches per message via an external marker; then test a loopback marker URL field by field (type:request, fetch, proxy, etc.) — a positive requires the backend client/egress proxy and target service recording the same token; messages carrying file or gopher confirm protocol forwarding. Never touch metadata, real files, or Redis. WebSocket ACKs, browser requests, connection timeouts, or stored command strings are insufficient. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 对动作与字段做 schema 允许列表，仅允许 HTTPS 目标；解析后阻断内网、回环与链路本地，禁用 file/gopher 并在重定向后重检。修复后重放相同对照，合法 WebSocket 功能保留而越权取回能力消失。
mitigation.en: Apply schema allowlists over actions and fields, allowing only HTTPS targets; block intranets, loopback, and link-local after resolution, disable file/gopher, and recheck after redirects. After the fix, replay the same controls: legitimate WebSocket features remain while unauthorized fetching disappears.

title.zh: 建立 WebSocket 驱动服务端请求

description.zh: 连接目标 WebSocket 后发送 {"type":"request","url":"http://127.0.0.1/"} 消息；服务端返回对应响应体即 WS 消息可充当 SSRF 通道。
description.en: Connect to the target's WebSocket and send a {"type":"request","url":"http://127.0.0.1/"} message; the server returning the fetched body makes WS messages an SSRF channel.

title.en: Sweep the intranet by template swaps

description.zh: 沿用第 1 步消息模板替换 8080、3306、6379 等端口与内网 IP；按返回 banner 差异绘制内网服务地图。
description.en: Reuse the step-1 message template with ports 8080, 3306, 6379 and intranet IPs; banner differences map the internal services.

title.zh: 深入云元数据窃取凭证

description.zh: 在授权深入阶段把 url 字段换成云元数据 iam/security-credentials 路径以证明影响（返回角色名或凭据键名即表明 WS 通道可拖取实例角色凭证）；验证类测试不读取 AccessKeyId 正文，元数据行不作为初始证明。
description.en: Swap the url field to the iam/security-credentials metadata path; AccessKeyId in the response completes cloud credential theft over the WS channel.

attackChain.payload:
// 帧1 (opcode=text, FIN=0): {"type":"request","url":"http://127
// 帧2 (opcode=0 continuation, FIN=1): .0.0.1/"}

analysis.zh: 第 0–23 条与第 28–35 条（0 基序号）是不同字段的 URL/scheme SSRF 候选；第 24–27 条的 command= curl/wget 只有在服务器执行完整命令时才是命令执行路径，不能仅凭字符串报告 RCE 或 SSRF。成功必须是服务端实际出站到受控目标，file/gopher/元数据行不能作为初始证明。
analysis.en: Lines 0-23 and 28-35 are URL or scheme SSRF candidates across fields. Command lines 24-27 become command-execution paths only if the server runs the complete curl or wget command; the string alone proves neither RCE nor SSRF. Success requires actual server egress to a controlled target, and file, gopher, or metadata lines are not initial proof.

opsecTips.zh: 首次收到后端回环标记请求后停止，不访问云凭据、真实内部端口、系统文件或 Redis 命令。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the first backend request reaches the loopback marker and do not access cloud credentials, real internal ports, system files, or Redis commands.

opsecTips.zh: 关闭标记服务与 WebSocket，清除 DNS/HTTP 缓存和重试队列，删除消息及出站日志中的内部 URL。
opsecTips.en: Close marker services and the WebSocket, clear DNS and HTTP caches and retry queues, and remove internal URLs from messages and egress logs.

review.rationale: 核心行为是 WebSocket worker 代发请求，真实分类为 SSRF；command 字段边界已单独说明。

lineSemantics.note: Request, fetch, and proxy envelopes target server-side URL dispatch across HTTP, file, and gopher schemes.
curl and wget strings require independent proof of server-side command execution and must not be inferred from storage or acknowledgment.
Generic url, uri, and endpoint fields require proof that the backend consumes them as destinations.

description.zh: 绕过对帧内明文 URL 的扫描：斜杠转义为 \/ 由 JSON 解码还原；服务端发出内部请求即成功。
description.en: Escape slashes for JSON-decoded restoration past plaintext frame scanning; the server issuing an internal request confirms success.

wafBypass.command:
// 帧1 (opcode=text, FIN=0): {"type":"request","url":"http://127
// 帧2 (opcode=0 continuation, FIN=1): .0.0.1/"}

description.zh: 绕过按完整帧匹配的检测：把消息拆成续帧序列，重组后才含完整 URL；服务端仍处理请求即成功。
description.en: Deliver the message as fragmented continuation frames reassembled past whole-frame matching; the server still processing the request confirms success.

title.zh: 短格式回环与字段变体

description.zh: 绕过对 127.0.0.1 与小写 type 键的固定匹配：缩写回环与 IPv6 加键名变形组合；内部响应返回即成功。
description.en: Combine abbreviated loopback, IPv6, and key-case variants past fixed matching; an internal response returning confirms success.

title.zh: WS SSRF (通过WS代理请求内部服务)
title.en: Validation step 1 for WebSocket-Driven Server-Side Request Forgery

description.zh: 逐条发送 WS 请求调度消息并记录响应与出站日志；成功时服务端代为取回对应 URL 并返回内容，含 file 或 gopher 时确认协议转发。
description.en: Send each WS request-dispatch message and record responses and egress logs; the server fetching the URL and returning content, including file or gopher schemes, confirms protocol forwarding.

name.zh: WebSocket 消息级认证与授权绕过
name.en: WebSocket Message-Level Authentication and Authorization Bypass

description.zh: 测试空值、类型混淆、弱凭据和会话字段是否被 WebSocket 消息处理器错误接受，并验证连接后每条消息的主体授权。
description.en: Tests whether empty values, type confusion, weak credentials, and session fields are incorrectly accepted by a WebSocket message handler and whether each message is authorized after connection.

subCategory.zh: 消息级授权与生命周期

prerequisites.zh: 使用两个权限不同的自有测试账号，记录握手认证、消息级 auth/login 状态机和服务端最终主体。
prerequisites.en: Use two owned test accounts with different privileges and record handshake authentication, message-level auth or login state, and the final server principal.

prerequisites.zh: 所有 token/session/cookie 样例替换为测试凭据；禁止使用 `STOLEN_SESSION` 或默认管理员真实口令。
prerequisites.en: Replace all token, session, and cookie samples with test credentials and never use `STOLEN_SESSION` or real default administrator passwords.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 WebSocket 消息级认证与授权场景，检验连接后每条消息的主体校验与类型处理。验证维度为空值、类型混淆与弱凭据消息的提交矩阵，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers WebSocket message-level authentication and authorization, testing per-message principal validation and type handling after connection. Validation is a submission matrix of empty, type-confused and weak-credential messages, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于授权只在连接建立时执行而消息处理器直接信任载荷：伪造 auth 消息或类型混淆值让会话在连接内被提升或读取受限数据。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is authorization running only at connection setup while message handlers trust payloads outright: forged auth messages or type-confused values elevate sessions in-connection or expose restricted data.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步按脚本把空值、null、字符串化布尔与角色提升消息逐条经既有连接发送，记录服务端响应与会话状态变化：任一伪造消息被接受或返回受限数据即确认消息级授权缺失。成功判据以响应与状态变化为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, send empty, null, stringified-boolean and role-elevation messages one by one over the existing connection per the script, recording server responses and session-state changes; any forged message accepted or restricted data returned confirms missing message-level authorization. Judge success by responses and state changes. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 每条消息都对照连接主体执行授权并拒绝类型异常载荷，auth 类消息绑定一次性挑战。修复后重放第 1 步矩阵，全部伪造消息应被拒绝并断开计数。
mitigation.en: Authorize every message against the connection principal and refuse type-anomalous payloads, binding auth messages to one-time challenges. After the fix, replay the step 1 matrix: every forged message should be rejected with disconnect tallies.

description.zh: 直连 WS 端点观察握手是否强制认证；连接成功并收到欢迎消息即说明鉴权推迟到消息层，进入消息级攻击阶段。
description.en: Connect directly and see whether the handshake enforces auth; a socket that opens and greets means auth lives in the message layer.

attackChain.payload: {"type":"auth","session":"{LAB_OWN_SESSION_ID}"}；{"type":"auth","cookie":"session={LAB_OWN_SESSION}"}

description.zh: 逐条提交空 token、null、undefined、0 等类型混淆与字段篡改的认证消息；服务端把无效身份绑定为高权限主体即消息级授权缺失。
description.en: Submit auth messages with empty, null, undefined and 0 tokens plus field tampering; a server binding invalid input to a privileged subject lacks message-level authz.

attackChain.payload: {"type":"auth","session":"{LAB_OWN_SESSION_ID}"}；{"type":"auth","cookie":"session={LAB_OWN_SESSION}"}

title.zh: 以提升身份调用受保护操作
title.en: Invoke protected actions as the elevated identity

description.zh: 用第 2 步获得的会话身份调用管理类消息或读取他人数据；操作成功返回即完成 WebSocket 消息级越权，量化可访问的数据范围。
description.en: Using the session minted in step 2, call admin messages or read other users' data; successful responses complete the message-level privilege escalation.

attackChain.payload: {"type":"auth","session":"{LAB_OWN_SESSION_ID}"}；{"type":"auth","cookie":"session={LAB_OWN_SESSION}"}

analysis.zh: 空字符串、null、`"null"`、0、-1 与 method=none 只用于检测类型/状态机错误；admin/admin 等弱凭据成功是凭据策略问题，不自动等于认证绕过。会话字段必须仅用自有测试会话。只有最终主体或对象权限越界才是阳性。
analysis.en: Empty string, null, `"null"`, zero, minus one, and method=none probe type and state-machine flaws. Success with admin/admin is a credential-policy issue and not automatically an auth bypass. Session fields must use owned test sessions. Only an incorrect final principal or object-authorization boundary is positive.

opsecTips.zh: 首次证明测试低权限账号获得一项越权读取后停止，不修改对象、发送管理消息或尝试真实会话 ID。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the test low-privilege account gains one unauthorized read and do not modify objects, send administrative messages, or try real session IDs.

opsecTips.zh: 注销并撤销所有测试 token/session，关闭套接字，删除 auth 消息日志中的凭据并恢复测试账号权限。
opsecTips.en: Log out and revoke all test tokens and sessions, close sockets, remove credentials from auth-message logs, and restore test-account permissions.

review.rationale: 这是 WebSocket 认证状态机和对象授权问题，真实分类为认证漏洞。

description.zh: 绕过按 {"type":"auth","token":...} 固定键序做匹配的消息过滤：调换键序、插入空白、尾逗号（宽容解析器）、\u 转义键与数组包裹后语义不变而签名失效；成功判据：变形消息仍被接受并进入已认证状态。
description.en: Bypasses message filters matching the fixed {"type":"auth","token":...} key order: reordered keys, whitespace, trailing commas (lenient parsers), \u-escaped keys and array wrapping keep semantics while breaking signatures; success criterion: variant messages are still accepted into an authenticated state.

description.zh: 绕过只校验 token 字段的消息级认证：探测 accessToken/api_key/jwt/sessionId/session/authorization 等别名分支是否漏校验空值；成功判据：任一别名字段使服务端返回认证成功回执。
description.en: Bypasses message-level auth validating only the token field: probe accessToken/api_key/jwt/sessionId/session/authorization alias branches for missing empty-value checks; success criterion: any alias field yields a successful auth acknowledgment.

title.zh: token 类型混淆（嵌套/数组/布尔）

description.zh: 绕过对字符串 token 做真值判断的认证实现：对象/数组/布尔值在弱类型判断（truthy 检查或 !isEmpty 误用）下可能直接通过；成功判据：任一非字符串形态收到认证成功响应。
description.en: Bypasses auth implementations truth-testing a string token: objects/arrays/booleans can pass weak checks (truthy tests or misused !isEmpty); success criterion: any non-string shape receives a successful auth response.

title.zh: 跳过 auth 直接发业务消息

description.zh: 绕过"认证后才处理消息"的假设：不发送 auth 直接发业务/订阅/心跳消息，探测消息分发器是否在未认证状态下处理非 auth 类型；成功判据：收到业务回执（含 marker 的 echo 或订阅确认）即为未认证访问成立。
description.en: Bypasses the assumption that messages are only handled after auth: skip auth and send business/subscribe/heartbeat messages directly to test whether the dispatcher processes non-auth types unauthenticated; success criterion: any business acknowledgment (marker echo or subscribe confirm) proves unauthenticated access.

description.zh: 绕过对明文 "null"/空串 token 的过滤与对 JWT 结构的盲信：bnVsbA==（null）、e30=（{}）与 alg:none 的 JWT 三段形态可能被直接解析通过；成功判据：任一伪造形态获得认证成功回执。
description.en: Bypasses filters on plaintext "null"/empty tokens and blind trust in JWT structure: bnVsbA== (null), e30= ({}) and an alg:none three-segment JWT may parse straight through; success criterion: any forged shape receives a successful auth acknowledgment.

title.en: Validation step 1 for WebSocket Message-Level Authentication and Authorization Bypass

description.zh: 把消息级认证绕过载荷逐条经 WebSocket 发送；服务端按伪造消息提升会话或返回受限数据，即确认消息级授权缺失。
description.en: Send each message-level auth-bypass payload over WebSocket; the server elevating the session or returning restricted data per forged messages confirms missing message-level authorization.

name.zh: WebSocket 消息与 HTTP 边界走私探针
name.en: WebSocket Message and HTTP Boundary-Smuggling Probes

description.zh: 比较同一 WebSocket 帧内连续 JSON 文档与嵌入 HTTP 请求文本，验证网关、消息解析器和后端是否产生边界分歧。
description.en: Compares concatenated JSON documents in one WebSocket frame with embedded HTTP request text to test boundary disagreements among gateways, message parsers, and backends.

prerequisites.zh: 能够抓取 WebSocket 帧边界、应用 JSON 解析事件与任何 HTTP 网关/后端连接，确认消息是否跨协议转发。
prerequisites.en: Capture WebSocket frame boundaries, application JSON parse events, and any HTTP gateway or backend connection to determine whether messages cross protocols.

prerequisites.zh: 使用隔离 `/admin` 测试路由和无副作用操作，后端日志可区分一个帧、两个 JSON 值与一个合法 HTTP 请求。
prerequisites.en: Use an isolated `/admin` test route with a side-effect-free action, and backend logs that distinguish one frame, two JSON values, and one valid HTTP request.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 WebSocket 与 HTTP 边界走私探针场景，检验网关、消息解析器与后端对帧内多文档与嵌入 HTTP 文本的边界分歧。验证维度为连续 JSON 文档与原始请求片段的边界对照，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers WebSocket versus HTTP boundary-smuggling probes, testing boundary disagreements across gateway, message parsers and backends for multi-document frames and embedded HTTP text. Validation contrasts consecutive JSON documents with raw request fragments, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于升级后链路对帧边界与 HTTP 消息边界的处理不一致：帧内嵌入的请求文本被某层当作独立 HTTP 消息解析，走私通道由此打开。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is inconsistent handling of frame versus HTTP message boundaries along the upgraded chain: request text embedded in frames gets parsed as independent HTTP messages at some layer, opening the smuggling channel.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步按脚本在边界连接上逐条发送连续 JSON 与嵌入 HTTP 片段，观察网关与后端日志的解析分歧：嵌入请求被独立执行或日志出现额外请求即确认边界走私可行。成功判据以后端日志中的额外请求为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；目标限定授权实验路径。
exploitation.en: In step 1, send consecutive JSON and embedded HTTP fragments over boundary connections one by one per the script, watching gateway-versus-backend parse divergence; embedded requests executing independently or extra requests in logs confirm feasible boundary smuggling. Judge success by extra requests in backend logs. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; targets restricted to authorized lab paths.

mitigation.zh: 网关对升级连接禁用帧内容到 HTTP 的二次解析并统一消息边界实现，监控单帧多文档异常。修复后重放第 1 步，嵌入请求应保持为纯文本消息且无额外执行。
mitigation.en: Gateways must disable re-parsing frame content into HTTP on upgraded connections, unify message-boundary implementations, and alert on multi-document frames. After the fix, replay step 1: embedded requests should stay plain-text messages with no extra execution.

title.zh: 建立正常 WS 会话

description.zh: 完成 WS 握手并收发一条合法 JSON 消息；确认默认的每帧一消息行为，作为后续边界攻击的参照形态。
description.en: Complete the handshake and exchange one legal JSON message; the default one-message-per-frame behavior anchors the boundary attacks.

title.zh: 同帧拼接探测解析边界
title.en: Probe parsing boundaries with same-frame concatenation

description.zh: 在同一帧内拼接两条 JSON 消息，并把原始 HTTP 片段混入消息文本发送；服务端解析出独立消息或把片段按 HTTP 处理即暴露边界分歧。
description.en: Concatenate two JSON messages in one frame and mix raw HTTP fragments into message text; independent parsing or HTTP-style handling exposes the boundary flaw.

title.zh: 借边界分歧扩大上下文
title.en: Abuse the divergence to reach new contexts

description.zh: 利用代理与后端对帧内内容的解释差异，把第二段内容送入管理路径或他人会话上下文；受控内容到达错误上下文即完成消息走私。
description.en: Exploit differing interpretations of frame content to deliver the second segment into admin paths or another user's context; landing in the wrong context completes the smuggling.

analysis.zh: 第 0 行为同一帧内两个 JSON 对象粘包的消息边界探针；第 1、2 行为合规 HTTP 请求（Content-Length: 13 的 POST 与携带 Cookie 的 GET），用于观察网关是否把 WebSocket 帧内容升级为独立请求，并对比两跳日志。
analysis.en: Line 0 is a same-frame double-JSON concatenation probe for message boundaries; lines 1 and 2 are compliant HTTP requests (a POST with Content-Length: 13 and a GET carrying a cookie) used to observe whether the gateway upgrades frame content into standalone requests, compared across both hops' logs.

opsecTips.zh: 首次确认受控第二 JSON 值被错误解析后停止，不向真实管理路由发送删除动作，也不跨租户连接。
opsecTips.en: Stop after a controlled second JSON value is misparsed and do not send delete actions to real administration routes or cross tenant connections.

opsecTips.zh: 关闭测试 WebSocket/后端连接，删除隔离路由记录，清空代理缓冲与连接池，并确认无半开 HTTP 请求残留。
opsecTips.en: Close test WebSocket and backend connections, delete isolated-route records, drain proxy buffers and pools, and verify no half-open HTTP request remains.

review.rationale: 真实问题是消息/协议边界分歧；两条缺少 CRLF 的 HTTP 原例已由 stale-safe 命令补丁改成带请求行、头部边界、Content-Length 与终止空行的无害 preview/status 测试请求。

description.en: Framing headers on the handshake smuggle into the long-lived socket. Success: admin response arrives over WS.
