description.en: Plaintext HTTP after the upgrade crosses the protocol boundary. Success: backend processes the smuggled request.

description.zh: 以 WS 二进制帧封装 HTTP 文本利用消息到 HTTP 边界差异。判据：内网响应回显。
description.en: HTTP text inside a binary WS frame. Success: internal response echoed.

title.zh: 跨域 WS 走私凭据

description.zh: 浏览器 WS 帧内嵌 HTTP 文本借同源 Cookie 走私。判据：API 状态被改变。
description.en: Browser WS frame embeds HTTP text with same-origin cookies. Success: API state changed.

title.en: Validation step 1 for WebSocket Message and HTTP Boundary-Smuggling Probes

description.zh: 把 WS 消息与原始 HTTP 片段逐条在边界发送；消息边界被解析为独立 HTTP 请求，即确认边界走私探针有效。
description.en: Send each WS-message and raw-HTTP fragment across the boundary; message boundaries parsed as independent HTTP requests confirm the boundary-smuggling probes.

name.zh: 跨源 opener 导航能力对照

description.zh: 比较对 opener.location 的赋值、href/replace/assign 调用、跨源 document 访问及 data/javascript URL，验证同源策略允许和阻止的能力。
description.en: Compares assignment to opener.location, href, replace, assign, cross-origin document access, and data or javascript URLs to test capabilities allowed and blocked by same-origin policy.

prerequisites.zh: 通过显式 rel=opener 或无 noopener 的脚本 window.open 建立受控 opener，并确认 COOP 未将浏览上下文组分离。
prerequisites.en: Establish a controlled opener through explicit rel=opener or script window.open without noopener and confirm COOP does not separate the browsing context group.

prerequisites.zh: opener 与新页使用不同受控源，导航只指向无害标记页，并捕获 SecurityError、控制台与导航日志。
prerequisites.en: Use different controlled origins for opener and child, navigate only to a harmless marker page, and capture SecurityError, console, and navigation logs.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖跨源 opener 导航能力对照场景，检验同源策略下对原窗口 location 的可写边界。验证维度为赋值、href、replace 与跨源读取的逐项对照，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers cross-origin opener navigation capability comparisons, testing same-origin-policy boundaries on writing the original window's location. Validation itemizes assignment, href, replace and cross-origin reads, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于同源策略允许跨源写 opener.location 而阻止读：保留 opener 的页面被打开后可把原窗口导航到伪造登录页，完成钓鱼接力。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the same-origin policy allowing cross-origin writes to opener.location while blocking reads: pages retaining opener can navigate the original window to forged login pages, completing a phishing relay.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步按脚本在不同导航写法下打开对照页并逐项检查 opener 可用性与导航效果：opener 可写且原窗口被定向到伪造页即确认导航能力未隔离，同时记录读取被拒的同源策略边界。成功判据以导航成功与读取拒绝矩阵为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, open comparison pages under each navigation style per the script, itemizing opener availability and navigation effects; writable openers steering the original window to forged pages confirm unisolated navigation, with same-origin read rejections recorded alongside. Judge success by the navigation-success versus read-rejection matrix. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 全部出站链接与 window.open 调用强制 noopener noreferrer，钓鱼页面防护依赖浏览器孤立上下文。修复后重放第 1 步，所有写法的 opener 应为空且导航无从发起。
mitigation.en: Force noopener noreferrer on all outbound links and window.open calls, relying on browser context isolation against phishing pages. After the fix, replay step 1: opener should be null across every style, making navigation impossible.

title.zh: 确认 opener 引用可达
title.en: Confirm the opener reference is reachable

description.zh: 从目标站外链打开可控子页并检查 window.opener 是否非空；引用存在即具备反向导航目标页面的能力基础，进入写法测试。
description.en: Open a controlled child via the site's external link and check window.opener; a non-null reference is the prerequisite for navigating the parent.

analysis.zh: 跨源情况下，`window.opener.location =`、`.href =` 与规范暴露的 `replace()` 可作为受控导航候选；`assign()` 并非跨源暴露方法，`window.opener.document.*` 会受 SOP 阻止。data 与 javascript 顶级导航在现代浏览器受到额外限制，不能从字符串存在推断执行。所有测试还要求 opener 非空。
analysis.en: Cross-origin assignment to `window.opener.location`, `.href`, and the exposed `replace()` method are controlled-navigation candidates. `assign()` is not a cross-origin exposed method, and `window.opener.document.*` is blocked by SOP. Top-level data and javascript navigation face additional modern restrictions and cannot be inferred from string presence. Every case also requires a non-null opener.

opsecTips.zh: 原窗口首次导航到本地标记页后停止，不使用钓鱼表单、data 页面、javascript 写入或真实账号会话。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the original window first navigates to a local marker page; do not use phishing forms, data pages, javascript writes, or real account sessions.

opsecTips.zh: 关闭父子窗口，清理历史记录、站点数据和导航日志，恢复 noopener/COOP 并删除临时标记页。
opsecTips.en: Close parent and child windows, clear history, site data, and navigation logs, restore noopener and COOP, and delete the temporary marker page.

review.rationale: 这是 opener 跨源导航/Tabnabbing 能力对照，不是 XSS；修正了原名称乱码。

Top-level data and javascript navigations face modern browser restrictions and cannot be assumed to execute.

description.en: Navigate equivalently via replace() past assignment-statement rules, with no history entry; the original window being replaced confirms success.

description.en: Drive the opener indirectly via a cross-document message where the peer trusts navigation requests; the original window changing confirms success.

description.en: Hang the navigation on refocus to delay past detection windows; the opener redirecting when the user returns confirms success.

description.en: Check window.opener availability from the new window and test each navigation form; the opener being redirected to a spoofed page confirms unisolated opener navigation.

name.zh: 反向 Tabnabbing opener 正负对照
name.en: Reverse-Tabnabbing Opener Positive and Negative Controls

description.zh: 比较 rel=opener、冲突 rel 关键字与 window.open feature，验证新页面是否真实持有 opener 并可受控导航原窗口。
description.en: Compares rel=opener, conflicting rel keywords, and window.open features to determine whether a new page truly retains opener and can navigate the original window.

prerequisites.zh: 父页、子页和无害导航目标均由授权测试域控制，记录浏览器版本、COOP 与 window.open 返回值。
prerequisites.en: Parent, child, and harmless navigation destination are controlled, with browser version, COOP, and window.open return values recorded.

prerequisites.zh: 子页只检查 opener 是否为空并导航到固定标记页，不显示认证界面或收集用户输入。
prerequisites.en: The child only checks whether opener is null and navigates to a fixed marker page, without authentication UI or user-input collection.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖反向标签劫持的 opener 正负对照场景，检验不同 rel 与 open 组合下原窗口控制权归属。验证维度为 opener 关键字、冲突 rel 与 open 特性的对照矩阵，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers reverse-tabnabbing opener positive-negative comparisons, testing original-window control across rel and open combinations. Validation is a comparison matrix of opener keywords, conflicting rel values and open features, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于 rel 关键字冲突时浏览器取宽松解释且 open 特性可显式请求 opener：外部页面获得原窗口引用后即可实施反向劫持。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is browsers taking lenient interpretations on conflicting rel keywords while open features can request opener explicitly: external pages gaining the original-window reference execute reverse hijacks.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步按脚本部署各组合的打开对照页，在新窗口检查 opener 并尝试反向导航原窗口：任一组合保留控制权即确认劫持可行，统计各浏览器版本的行为差异。成功判据以控制权保留矩阵为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, deploy open-comparison pages per combination per the script, checking opener in the new window and attempting reverse navigation of the original; any combination retaining control confirms hijack feasibility, tallying behavior differences across browser versions. Judge success by the control-retention matrix. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 链接与脚本打开统一显式 noopener 并审计冲突 rel 用法，关键页面加离开确认缓解静默替换。修复后重放第 1 步矩阵，全部组合的 opener 应为空。
mitigation.en: Unify explicit noopener across links and scripted opens with audits of conflicting rel usage, adding leave confirmations on critical pages against silent swaps. After the fix, replay the step 1 matrix: opener should be null for every combination.

description.zh: 在可控页面准备 target=_blank 配 rel=opener、opener 与 noopener 混写及 window.open 等多种打开方式，等待或诱导目标站引用这些链接。
description.en: Stage links mixing target=_blank with rel=opener, conflicting keywords and window.open; wait for or bait the target site into hosting them.

title.zh: 验证 opener 保留与可控
title.en: Verify the opener survives and is controllable

description.en: Open children with each staged combination and check opener; non-null references that allow navigation identify the exploitable idiom.

title.en: Navigate the parent from the child

description.zh: 子页执行 opener.location 跳向钓鱼域；父页面被静默替换即完成反向 tabnabbing，收割回访用户输入的登录凭据。
description.en: The child sets opener.location to the phishing domain; the silently replaced parent harvests credentials from returning users.

attackChain.payload: Click here Click here Click here Click here Click here window.open("https://{ATTACKER_HOST}/tabnabbing", "_blank") window.open("https://{ATTACKER_HOST}/tabnabbing", "_blank", "noopener") window.open("https://{ATTACKER_HOST}/tabnabbing", "_blank", "noreferrer") window.open("https://{ATTACKER_HOST}/tabnabbing", "_blank", "noopener,noreferrer")

analysis.zh: 行 0 的 rel=opener 与行 3/5 的无 noopener window.open 是阳性候选；行 1 中 noopener 应压过 opener，行 2 的 noreferrer 蕴含 noopener，行 6-8 明确切断 opener。行 4 从父页执行 `w.opener.location`，实际导航的是父页自身引用，不证明恶意子页控制 opener，应作为逻辑负对照。
analysis.en: Line 0 with rel=opener and lines 3 or 5 using window.open without noopener are positive candidates. Noopener should dominate opener on line 1, noreferrer implies noopener on line 2, and lines 6-8 explicitly sever opener. Line 4 runs `w.opener.location` from the parent and navigates the parent's own reference; it does not prove control by a malicious child and is a logical negative control.

opsecTips.zh: 子页首次把父页导航到本地标记后停止，不生成钓鱼内容、不收集凭据，也不测试真实外部站点。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the child first navigates the parent to a local marker; do not generate phishing content, collect credentials, or test real external sites.

opsecTips.zh: 关闭所有弹窗/标签，清除历史与站点数据，恢复 COOP/链接属性并删除父子测试页及日志。
opsecTips.en: Close all popups and tabs, clear history and site data, restore COOP and link attributes, and delete parent and child test pages and logs.

review.rationale: 该条保留为 Tabnabbing 正负对照，明确冲突关键字与错误自我导航示例。

lineSemantics.note: Explicit rel=opener can retain opener when browser policy permits.
noopener suppresses opener even when opener is also listed.
